name: cav-skills
description: A 12-skill depth pack for CAV, the International Conference on Computer Aided Verification: routing formal-methods work among CAV, TACAS, FMCAD, VMCAI, POPL/PLDI, and journals; the three CAV 2027 submission categories (Regular, Tool, Application / Industrial Experience / Case Study) in Springer LNCS; the two-stage review with early reject and rebuttal; partial double-anonymity; the AEC artifact evaluation (Available / Functional / Reusable badges; mandatory for Tool Papers); verification-tool reproducibility on SV-COMP/SMT-COMP benchmarks with seeds, resource limits, and proof witnesses; and the LNCS camera-ready. Grounded in the CAV 2027 (Amsterdam) call and artifact-evaluation pages re-verified on 2026-11-24, Springer LNCS proceedings, i-cav.org, and dblp.
